propositions: REVIEW_RESULT events carry metrics blocks with llm_calls and latency fields; COMPLETION_VERDICT events do not and must not be used for cost derivations
cost_per_accepted_change is computed by summing llm_calls from all REVIEW_RESULT records divided by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when no accepted closes exist
first_pass_verification measures the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first chronological order) COMPLETION_VERDICT record is a completion_verifier_pass_v1

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 record with the next same-gate PASS record on the ticket stream by matching the ERROR record's gate field to the next PASS of that gate type, yielding the timestamp delta or remaining open if no following PASS exists

the reader performs a single raw ordered scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files per ticket sorted by filename epoch prefix, reading event data and timestamps without using reducer schema helpers
